title: PhySchema
description: A Grasshopper definition serialised as JSON. Output exactly this structure — no prose, no markdown fences, no explanation. Only the raw JSON object.
rules: The grounding's installed-component list, when present, is the sole source of truth for which components may be placed: use only names it contains — plug-in components (Pufferfish, LunchBox, etc.) are allowed when listed, and unlisted components are not allowed however common. Without such a list, keep to native Grasshopper components. Never use scripting components (Python, C#, GhPython, VB).

Every input parameter that receives a wire needs its own separate entry in the connections array. A component with three wired inputs (e.g. Construct Point X, Y, Z) requires three separate connection entries pointing to it.
paramName values are case-sensitive and must exactly match the canonical names in componentCatalog. For components not listed, use the full GH parameter Name, not the short NickName.

Do not leave required inputs unwired. An unwired Construct Point always outputs world origin (0,0,0); an unwired radius defaults to 0. Trace every component's inputs and confirm each has a connection.
Number Slider componentState value format is 'default<min~max>', e.g. '5<0~10>'.

Give every Number Slider (and any other input source, e.g. a Boolean Toggle) a nickName naming what it controls — 'Radius', 'Height', 'Point Count' — so the definition reads clearly on the canvas. Keep it short (one or two words) and specific to this slider's role. Other components may take a nickName too, but it is optional for them.
All component id values must be unique integers. All instanceGuid values must be unique UUID v4 strings.

componentCatalog.description: Canonical paramName values for common Grasshopper components. Use these exactly in connections. This is a convenience listing, not the set of allowed components — that set comes from the grounding's installed-component list.

components.description: All Grasshopper components in the definition.

nickName.description: Optional canvas label describing what this component is for. Required in spirit for every input source (Number Slider, Boolean Toggle): name it after what it controls, e.g. 'Radius', 'Height'. Short and specific.

instanceGuid.description: A UUID v4 string, unique within the definition.

id.description: Short integer identifier used in the connections array. Must be unique.

componentState.description: Optional extra state. Omit for standard components.

extensions.description: Provider-specific extensions keyed by extension name, e.g. 'gh.numberslider'.

connections.description: Wires between component parameters. One entry per wire — a component with N wired inputs needs N entries, one per input parameter.

paramName.description: Output parameter name on the source component.
Input parameter name on the target component.

examples.description: Three sliders drive all three inputs of a Construct Point, which feeds the Base of a Sphere. A fourth slider sets the Radius. Each slider is nicknamed for what it controls. This also demonstrates that every input needs its own connection entry.
